About.title: About
About.p1: I build React interfaces focused on real business impact — not just shipping components. As the sole frontend engineer on a B2B health platform, I've owned frontend decisions and delivery end-to-end: a full checkout rebuild that eliminated daily support interventions across the client base, and a financial statement module designed for lean bundle size and clear user value.
About.p2: Beyond my main role, I've independently delivered 10+ web projects and built TimeCode Sites — a Website-as-a-Service product with AI content generation, Stripe subscriptions, and custom domain provisioning — from idea to production, solo.
About.open: Open to global relocation and remote opportunities.

bullets: Rebuilt the entire logged-in checkout flow in React to support dynamic dependent addition, replacing a manual broker-dependent process — with real-time cost recalculation via Context API, a custom multi-step form, and tailored order finalization. Eliminated daily support interventions across 1,000+ client companies.

Built the financial statement module from scratch in React, reusing existing components to keep the bundle lean. Gave account holders direct visibility into financial history previously handled only through brokers — a key resource during annual income tax filing season.

Was the sole frontend on a B2B health platform serving 1,000+ companies and 25,000+ users — owned frontend decisions and delivery end-to-end, including admin data views for operations teams (company records, payments, statements, order queues).
Architected and shipped a multi-tenant SaaS platform in React 19 and TypeScript with a Node/Express backend — host-based tenant resolution, per-tenant routing and theming, and isolated data access.

Built an LLM content-generation pipeline with schema-validated structured JSON output (Zod), provider failover and retry/backoff; profiled and tuned provider routing to cut p50 latency from 60s to 5.7s.
Integrated Stripe billing (Checkout, Customer Portal, signature-verified webhooks) as an idempotent, event-driven state machine resilient to retries and out-of-order delivery.
Own infrastructure and delivery end-to-end: Docker Compose and Nginx on ARM64, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Cloudflare CDN, and server-side rendered meta tags for crawlers on custom domains.
Delivered 10+ client web projects end-to-end, from Figma handoff to production deployment, across varied niches and tight timelines.

Developed landing pages for Pedalgel from Figma into pixel-perfect responsive pages in Next.js, SCSS and CSS Modules, with an integrated external checkout. The product sold 60,000+ units and was exported to 10+ countries, including the US, Canada, Japan, and the UK.
Built additional web projects for the group's portfolio — including a digital entrepreneurship platform and a couples mentorship site — delivering across varied niches under tight timelines.

ProjectGutenberg.label: Featured project
ProjectGutenberg.title: Gutenberg Block System — B2B Health Platform
ProjectGutenberg.tagline: Custom blocks turning the WordPress editor into a document and data-view builder.
ProjectGutenberg.diagramAlt: Flow diagram: WordPress editor blocks save to a mount point, then render as React or PDF
ProjectGutenberg.problem: Legal and operations teams needed to assemble health insurance contracts and build admin data views without a developer in the loop — and the contracts had to come out as PDFs.
ProjectGutenberg.aha: The WordPress editor became the composition surface. Teams stack custom blocks — beneficiary data, dependents, billing, coverage terms, LGPD, page breaks — and the same content renders either as a hydrated React view in the browser or as a finished PDF contract.
decisions: Built and maintained the custom block library for the B2B admin theme: the registration layer (JS + PHP) and 6 blocks end-to-end — company records, payment listings, coparticipation statements, order resend queues.
Dynamic block pattern: save() emits a mount point that React hydrates on the frontend via data-component, keeping post content clean and rendering logic in the app layer.
Dual registration (JS for the editor, PHP register_block_type) under a dedicated block category, keeping ~37 domain blocks organised in the inserter.
Contributed to a ~20-block contract document system rendered to PDF — authored the page-break and single-invoice blocks, led development on three membership-form blocks.
Scale: platform serving 1,000+ client companies and 25,000+ users.
